content_zh:
“说起这大小姐，真不得不佩服她命运太好了，身为一个废物，却能够成为二皇子的未婚妻，皇子殿下也未因此嫌弃她，奈何她还不知道好歹，竟与人苟且！”
“失身也就算了，偏偏还怀孕了，更是闹得人尽皆知，让皇族颜面无存！”
“我还听说，白家为了补偿二皇子，已经将二小姐许配给他了，可二小姐被大小姐那样诬赖，还不计前嫌，打算劝说二皇子纳大小姐为妾，你说一个失身的女人，怎配成为皇家妾？亏得二小姐如此念着姐妹之情。”
外面窸窸窣窣的声音传入了房内，白颜安然的坐在床头，她的手指轻抚过尚且平坦的小腹，清澈如水的眸子平淡无波。
三个月前，她刚来到这片大陆，还没有来得及熟悉这里的环境，她的好妹妹白若就为她准备了一个丑陋的男人。
谁知她拼死逃出去之后，最终没能抵抗住体内的药性，在野外随便捡了个男人用来解毒。
虽然白若找到她的时候仅有她一人！但她身上的痕迹，还是说明了之前的那一切不是梦……
脑海里浮现出男人那一双嗜血的眸子，让白颜的目光出现了一抹恍惚，不知道是不是她当时中了药的缘故，她现在怎么也想不起那男人的容貌……
就好似，男人天生覆盖着一层薄雾，朦胧间窥视不到那一张容颜。
“姐。”
一道熟悉的声音将白颜的思绪拉了回来，她扬起头，正看见一名青涩俊美的翩翩少年从门外走了进来。
从记忆中得知，这少年是这具身体一母同胞的亲生弟弟白潇，也是她在这世上唯一的牵挂。
当年，他们的亲生母亲蓝月死后，白振祥就将小妾于蓉抬为了正室夫人，连带着两个庶女白若与白芷也一举爬到了他们的头上，若不是蓝家的威慑力还在，他们在白家将会变得毫无地位。
不过，时过境迁，已经有人忘记了，白家之所以有今天的地位，与蓝家脱不开关系！
当初，蓝家家主因为白振祥已经有了几房妾侍，不同意蓝月嫁给他，奈何蓝月以断绝父女关系为由，逼得蓝家家主不得不同意。
蓝家为了不让蓝月受到委屈，准备了十里红妆出嫁，轰动一时。
随后更是倾家荡产购买了无数丹药附赠给蓝月。
谁知蓝月无法抵抗白振祥的甜言蜜语，竟将所有丹药都拱手相送，白振祥亦是借助丹药一举突破天阶，入了一流世家。
可以说。白家今日的地位，是蓝月的牺牲换来的。
就连自己得知了这些事情都这么生气，也难怪蓝家老爷子气的这么多年对她不闻不问。

实在是被这个女儿伤透了心。
“姐，”白潇的小表情有些纠结，“你别太伤心了，二皇子和你退婚，是他的损失，我之前就见到二皇子和白若眉来眼去的，他们之间肯定不寻常。”

content_en:
"Speaking of this eldest lady, I really have to admire her for her good fate. Even though she is a loser, she can become the fiancée of the second prince. His Royal Highness does not dislike her because of this. However, she does not know what is good and what is good, and she is just getting along with others!"
"It's okay to lose my virginity, but she's still pregnant. It's made everyone famous, and it's brought shame to the royal family!"
"I also heard that in order to compensate the second prince, the Bai family had already betrothed the second young lady to him. However, the second young lady was falsely accused by the eldest lady and, regardless of the past, they planned to persuade the second prince to take the eldest lady as a concubine. How can a woman who has lost her virginity be worthy of becoming a royal concubine? Fortunately, the second young lady cherishes the love of sisterhood so much."
The rustling sounds outside entered the room, and Bai Yan sat peacefully on the bedside, her fingers gently stroking her flat belly, her clear and watery eyes calm and unruffled.
Three months ago, she had just arrived in this continent, and before she had time to get familiar with the environment, her good sister Bai Ruo prepared an ugly man for her.
Unexpectedly, after she desperately escaped, she couldn't resist the medicine in her body and picked up a random man in the wild to use it to detoxify.
Although she was the only one when Bai Ruo found her! But the marks on her body still showed that everything before was not a dream...
The man's bloodthirsty eyes appeared in her mind, which made Bai Yan's eyes appear dazed. She didn't know if it was because she was drugged at the time, but she couldn't remember the man's appearance now...
It's like a man is born covered with a layer of mist, and his face can't be seen dimly.
"Sister."
A familiar voice brought Bai Yan back from her thoughts. She raised her head and saw a young and handsome young man walking in from the door.
From her memory, she learned that this boy was Bai Xiao, the biological brother of this body's mother, and his only concern in the world.
Back then, after their biological mother Lan Yue died, Bai Zhenxiang raised his concubine Yu Rong as his wife, and the two concubines Bai Ruo and Bai Zhi also climbed over them in one fell swoop. If the Lan family's intimidation was not still there, they would have no status in the Bai family.
However, as time has passed, some people have forgotten that the reason why the Bai family has today's status is inseparable from the Lan family!
At first, the head of the Lan family did not agree to Lan Yue marrying him because Bai Zhenxiang already had several concubines. However, Lan Yue forced the head of the Lan family to agree on the grounds of severing the relationship between father and daughter.
In order to prevent Lan Yue from being wronged, the Lan family prepared a wedding with a red dress of ten miles, which caused a sensation.
Later, he spent all his money to buy countless pills and gave them to Lan Yue.
Unexpectedly, Lan Yue could not resist Bai Zhenxiang's sweet words and actually gave away all the elixirs. Bai Zhenxiang also used the elixirs to break through the heavenly ranks and join a first-class family.
It can be said. The current status of the Bai family was achieved through Lan Yue's sacrifice.
Even if she was so angry after learning about these things, it's no wonder that the old man of the Lan family was so angry that he ignored her for so many years.
I am really heartbroken by this daughter.
"Sister," Bai Xiao's expression was a little tangled, "don't be too sad. The second prince's breakup with you is his loss. I have seen the second prince and Bai Ruomei going back and forth before. There must be something unusual between them."
